summary_ocr_mean_confidence.rationale: A page-level mean below 0.90 warrants review, while structural checks decide whether extraction must stop.

summary_ocr_p10_confidence.rationale: The lower-confidence tail is monitored independently so a high mean cannot hide weak tokens.

period_header_coverage.rationale: Every configured summary table must expose all reporting periods before financial cells can be interpreted safely.

summary_row_label_assignment_rate.rationale: At least 90 percent of financial rows should retain labels; unlabeled values remain inspectable rather than guessed.

summary_period_cell_assignment_rate.rationale: Period-column mistakes directly change financial meaning and therefore require near-complete assignment.

note_location_confidence.rationale: A weak note location can route every later stage to unrelated pages.

note_data_cell_assignment_rate.rationale: Sparse OCR damage may be retained with warnings, but broad column-assignment failure requires review.

note_value_parse_success_rate.rationale: At least 80 percent of visibly numeric note cells should parse; lower rates trigger explicit partial-quality status.

relation_value_coverage.rationale: A required relation cannot be successful while a reporting period remains financially unexplained.

minimum_final_relation_confidence.rationale: This is an exploratory manual-review threshold, not a statistically calibrated probability cutoff.

structural_failure_count.rationale: Missing pages, periods, notes, tables, or referenced rows invalidate the output structure.

format_violation_count.rationale: Invalid confidence, bounding-box, or normalized-value representations violate the output contract.

financial_reconciliation_failure_count.rationale: An applicable exact financial reconciliation must not disagree silently.

financial_reconciliation_incomplete_coun.rationale: OCR-damaged inputs may prevent a reconciliation; incompleteness remains visible without inventing values.

upstream_warning_count.rationale: Warnings from extraction and model stages must propagate into the validation status.
